prompt: A vertical 9:16 photograph in the style of a 1970s British industrial documentary: a long, low banknote press hall under buzzing fluorescent tubes, a huge green-painted sheet-fed printing press running at speed, motion blur on its rollers. Uncut sheets of invented banknotes, in a muted purple and olive with an engraved heron and a crowned key, spill out of the delivery end and stack into a tall leaning pile. Nobody stands at the controls; an empty swivel chair, a clipboard and two buff envelopes stamped in red lie forgotten on a steel bench in the foreground. Kodak 35mm stock, 28mm lens, fine grain, oil sheen on the concrete floor. Thanks.
